page_title: MakLock — Free Mac App Locker with Touch ID & Apple Watch

summary.name: MakLock
summary.one_liner: MakLock is a free, open-source macOS app locker that protects chosen apps with Touch ID, Apple Watch proximity, or a password.
use_cases: Lock messaging apps on a shared Mac
Require Touch ID before opening sensitive apps
Auto-close messengers when the laptop sleeps
Unlock apps automatically with an Apple Watch
Hide app content from people nearby with a blur overlay
summary.what_it_does: MakLock runs in the menu bar and lets you choose which macOS apps to protect. It re-locks an app on every switch to it, not only on launch, and shows a blur overlay across all connected displays. Authentication can be Touch ID, an Apple Watch detected over Bluetooth Low Energy while on your wrist, or a password. Protected apps can re-lock on idle, on sleep, or when the Watch leaves range, and can auto-close after a per-app timeout or when the Mac sleeps. The page says it collects no telemetry and keeps settings on the device.
notable: Open source under the MIT license, with no subscriptions or feature gates
Apple Watch wrist detection over BLE, which the page says no other app locker has
Re-locks on every app activation, not just launch
Distributed outside the App Store with Developer ID signing and notarization
caveats: Not on the Mac App Store because sandboxing blocks full-screen overlays and app switch detection
Touch ID is not available on Macs without it, so a password is used as fallback
